tooltip.mioscoppergolems.unmarked: Use on the ground at the mine entrance
message.mioscoppergolems.plan_unmarked: Mark the entrance first: use the plan on the ground where the mine should start
message.mioscoppergolems.needs_pickaxe: The golem studies the plan. Now it needs a pickaxe.
message.mioscoppergolems.needs_plan: The golem holds the pickaxe. Now give it a mineshaft plan.
message.mioscoppergolems.farmer_ready: The golem is now a farmer and looks after the fields around its copper chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.farmer_no_chest: The golem is now a farmer. Link it to its copper chest: sneak + right-click the golem, then right-click the chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.worker_ready: The golem is now a %s and works around its copper chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.worker_no_chest: The golem is now a %s. Link it to its copper chest: sneak + right-click the golem, then right-click the chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.sorter_ready: The golem is now a sorter and empties its copper chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.sorter_needs_ho: The golem is now a sorter. Link it to the copper chest it should empty: sneak + right-click the golem, then right-click the chest.
message.mioscoppergolems.selected: Golem picked: %s. Right-click a copper chest to make it its home, or a chest or barrel to start a courier route.
message.mioscoppergolems.home_set: Home set to the copper chest at %s %s %s
message.mioscoppergolems.home_too_far: That chest is too far from the golem (more than 32 blocks).
message.mioscoppergolems.route_start: Route start set. Now right-click the chest or barrel the golem should bring everything to (any distance, you have 10 minutes).
message.mioscoppergolems.route_set: Courier route set: %s blocks. The golem carries everything from the first chest to the second.
message.mioscoppergolems.route_same_ches: That is the chest the route starts at. Pick a different one.
message.mioscoppergolems.trim_needs_mate: Template on. Now right-click the golem with a trim material (iron, gold, amethyst...).
